# Myelinate

> An open-source (MIT) skill suite that helps any assistant teach, including when this file is pasted in chat: course tutoring from your syllabus and uploads in chat or voice, assignment coaching that teaches instead of doing the work, learning while building, tests and grading, full course packages for projects or plain chat, level-matched teaching for personal, work and project goals, rendered diagrams and interactive 3D models, interactive learning labs, printable practice tests, flashcards, memory hooks, study plans, diagrams and videos, and adversarial accuracy review. It stays honest instead of agreeable.

If a person shared this link with you and asked you to teach them with it, read SKILL.md. It is self-sufficient; the sub-skills below are there if you can open them.

## Start here
- [SKILL.md (router and core rules)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Students-of-Local/myelinate/main/SKILL.md)

## Sub-skills
- [tutor: for an enrolled course: materials and uploads, course map, live teaching in chat or voice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Students-of-Local/myelinate/main/skills/tutor/SKILL.md)
- [teach: for personal, work and project goals: lessons matched to the learner’s level](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Students-of-Local/myelinate/main/skills/teach/SKILL.md)
- [assignment: graded work coached, not done for them](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Students-of-Local/myelinate/main/skills/assignment/SKILL.md)
- [project: learning while building, in the mix the learner chooses](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Students-of-Local/myelinate/main/skills/project/SKILL.md)
- [code: learning code the learner has to own: a repo, a PR, a library, an error](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Students-of-Local/myelinate/main/skills/code/SKILL.md)
- [notes: reads the learner's notes to see how they're grasping it](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Students-of-Local/myelinate/main/skills/notes/SKILL.md)
- [assess: tests, grading, gradebook, bonus work](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Students-of-Local/myelinate/main/skills/assess/SKILL.md)
- [course-project: a researched, level-matched whole course package for projects or plain chat](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Students-of-Local/myelinate/main/skills/course-project/SKILL.md)
- [lab: interactive learning labs and simulations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Students-of-Local/myelinate/main/skills/lab/SKILL.md)
- [print: printable practice tests, worksheets and diagrams (PDF)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Students-of-Local/myelinate/main/skills/print/SKILL.md)
- [flashcards: Quizlet, Anki and Obsidian decks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Students-of-Local/myelinate/main/skills/flashcards/SKILL.md)
- [game: typed exam study games with a memorize gate and delayed recheck](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Students-of-Local/myelinate/main/skills/game/SKILL.md)
- [memory-hooks: research-backed mnemonics](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Students-of-Local/myelinate/main/skills/memory-hooks/SKILL.md)
- [study-plan: exam clock, spaced relearning, sleep](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Students-of-Local/myelinate/main/skills/study-plan/SKILL.md)
- [find-media: diagrams, photos, videos, licensing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Students-of-Local/myelinate/main/skills/find-media/SKILL.md)
- [video: learning from a video, lecture, playlist or transcript](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Students-of-Local/myelinate/main/skills/video/SKILL.md)
- [make-video: narrated teaching videos built from checked sources, with pause questions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Students-of-Local/myelinate/main/skills/make-video/SKILL.md)
- [Video player page: paste a lesson file and watch it](https://students-of-local.github.io/myelinate/templates/video-player.html#load)
- [progress: wrapping up, coming back, can't start, how am I doing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Students-of-Local/myelinate/main/skills/progress/SKILL.md)
- [debrief: a graded exam came back, why each miss happened and what to change](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Students-of-Local/myelinate/main/skills/debrief/SKILL.md)
- [teacher: unit plans, rubrics and quizzes for teachers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Students-of-Local/myelinate/main/skills/teacher/SKILL.md)
- [verify: adversarial accuracy and currency review](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Students-of-Local/myelinate/main/skills/verify/SKILL.md)
